scope: Native eagle and phoenix projectiles, attack replacement, collision, slowdown, knockback, burn and saved animation; not full weapon or publisher-pixel acceptance

before.eagle: A normal arrow plus up to eight extra homing eagle shots, no native hit slowdown/frames/push
before.phoenix: Generic arrow with damage based on original target distance; no native growth, burn, piercing or images

after.selection: Eagle at floor(random*100)<10 replaces normal volley; phoenix always replaces it; Huang Zhong multi-arrow count retained
after.eagle: 187x124, .3/.5 pivot, 44x72 offset collider, four frames/100ms, straight 350px/s and 3x snapshotted power; one contact per enemy; hit flash and directional push
after.phoenix: 44x72, centered pivot, four frames/200ms, straight 1000px/s; scale=1+traveled/500; current owner power+floor(traveled/250), capped at double; promotion affects next target, replacement formation never borrowed
after.slowdown: speed coefficient x.2 at each hit, minimum .1, recovers +1 per second toward native coefficient
after.burn: Each phoenix hit adds independent fixed 10-point/2-second stack; shared immediate-next-step then 1-second tick, 70ms original flame frames, .5-second grow and fade; fatal tick settles before movement
after.knockback: direction*.3 grids impulse, saved velocity, .9 per 60Hz source frame normalized to fixed clock; nearest-road clamp and return waypoint
after.clocks: Drawn and released bird animation use original attack-start clock; burns, impacts, velocity, collision cache and return position saved
after.bounds: Saved current logical stage height +100; old saves default to authored 1386; horizontal -100..740

additionalCoverage: dead selected target does not remove straight bird
one collision per target and side isolation
fixed stacked burn, expiry and fatal settlement
malformed fields and legacy stage bounds

Framework source, plugin link and safety settings
